baseline_note: This packet targets the original fresh trend_rider lineage (the approximately 59% W1/W2/W3 win-rate baseline), not the delayed-fill exact-parent replay and not the long-only derivative. Any comparison must preserve the same baseline identity and report metric deltas explicitly.
objective: Raise the original trend_rider economic quality through distinct externally motivated causal axes while preserving anti-overfit, cost, lineage and fresh-validation gates. Win rate is an optimization metric but never a standalone acceptance target.

external_evidence.title: Systematic Trend-Following with Adaptive Portfolio Construction: Enhancing Risk-Adjusted Alpha in Cryptocurrency Markets
external_evidence.claim_used: Crypto trend performance is regime dependent; asymmetric long-short allocation and volatility-conditioned trailing can improve risk-adjusted outcomes.
external_evidence.limitations: Preprint evidence is hypothesis authority only. Reported 70/30 allocation and all fitted parameters are forbidden as imported thresholds.

external_evidence.title: Quantitative Evaluation of Volatility-Adaptive Trend-Following Models in Cryptocurrency Markets
external_evidence.claim_used: Multi-horizon trend confirmation, momentum confirmation, ATR risk adaptation and EMA-slope reversal exits are plausible distinct mechanisms for crypto trend systems.
external_evidence.limitations: The study used very large optimization search; no numeric parameter, threshold, horizon or optimized configuration may be copied. Only mechanism-level hypotheses are admitted.

external_evidence.title: Crypto has Fundamentals: A Seven-Factor Model for Digital Asset Returns
external_evidence.claim_used: Perpetual-futures funding sentiment may contain return information distinct from pure price momentum.
external_evidence.limitations: Funding is context only, not a direction oracle. Native timestamp-safe funding data and source parity are mandatory before evaluation.

external_evidence.title: Reconciling Open Interest with Traded Volume in Perpetual Swaps
external_evidence.claim_used: Open-interest data quality can be exchange dependent and internally inconsistent, so OI-based trend confirmation requires a stricter source-quality gate.
external_evidence.limitations: This is primarily a data-integrity warning, not evidence that OI improves trend alpha. OI evaluation remains blocked until native source integrity is verified.

repair_axes.mechanism: Preserve every original trend signal and exit; change only deterministic side-level capital weighting derived without outcome fitting. Hard long-only deletion is a separate axis and must not be silently substituted.
repair_axes.falsification: Reject if expectancy/PF/DD robustness does not improve without unacceptable retention loss, or if gains disappear under side leave-one-group-out diagnostics.

repair_axes.mechanism: Preserve the original trigger geometry and change only entry ownership according to predeclared completed-bar agreement across multiple trend horizons; no best-horizon search is allowed.
repair_axes.falsification: Reject if trade retention collapses, any chronological slice turns economically negative, or the improvement is concentrated in one horizon/symbol/regime.

repair_axes.mechanism: Preserve parent trend and exit geometry; change only entry ownership using one predeclared completed-bar momentum-confirmation transform. Numeric threshold sweeps and imported paper thresholds are forbidden.
repair_axes.falsification: Reject if the same transform does not improve both cost-adjusted expectancy and robustness or if negative controls reproduce the gain.

repair_axes.mechanism: Freeze original entry and initial risk. Allow exit ownership to respond only to a completed-bar reversal in the predeclared EMA-slope structure; no future MFE/MAE or outcome-conditioned exit selection.
repair_axes.falsification: Reject if payoff/PF or drawdown robustness worsens, or if the benefit depends on choosing the best exit horizon after observing outcomes.

repair_axes.mechanism: Freeze entry and initial risk; change only favorable-direction trailing distance using lagged completed-bar volatility state. Report signal edge separately from exit/risk-management gain.
repair_axes.falsification: Reject if improvement disappears under cost stress, leave-extreme-out, chronological split or volatility-regime leave-one-out tests.

repair_axes.mechanism: Preserve original trend direction and change only timestamp-safe context ownership around native funding state; never hardcode a universal funding interval.
repair_axes.falsification: Reject if funding source freshness/parity fails or if the context does not add robustness beyond price-only controls.

repair_axes.mechanism: Preserve original trend geometry and use OI only as timestamp-safe context after native source integrity and cross-checks pass.
repair_axes.falsification: Fail closed on implausible, stale, delayed or cross-source-inconsistent OI; reject if OI does not improve out-of-sample robustness.
